name: Globaldev Live Chat Inbox
author: Globaldev

sections.description:
Globaldev Live Chat Inbox provides a visitor live-chat widget and a support inbox directly inside WordPress. Conversations and messages are stored in this WordPress site’s database. No account with an outside chat provider is required to use the chat and inbox.

Features:
* Floating live chat widget with configurable corner placement, responsive layouts and colors.
* WordPress admin inbox for authorized agents with conversation history, replies and typing status.
* Separate agent role and per-agent access tokens for an authenticated REST API.
* Adjustable notification tones for visitors and agents (subject to browser sound restrictions).
* Data retention setting for closed conversations.

Android, iOS and Windows companion applications are coming soon. They are not included in this release, and are not required to use WordPress live chat. The Apps page allows support agents to create, copy once, and revoke device API keys for development testing; no companion-app download links are advertised. Native push notifications and realtime WebSocket transport are not included; the plugin uses periodic polling.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin in WordPress under Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate Globaldev Live Chat Inbox.
  3. Open Globaldev Live Chat Inbox > Settings, enable the widget and save your choices.
  4. Open Globaldev Live Chat Inbox > Inbox to respond to chat messages.
  5. Optionally create an agent user with the Live Chat Agent role. API keys for development clients can be generated under Globaldev Live Chat Inbox > Apps. Public companion app downloads are coming soon.
sections.faq:
Do I need a companion app to use this plugin?

No. The WordPress widget and admin inbox work independently. The Android, iOS and Windows applications are planned separately.

Where are messages stored?

Messages and conversations are stored in dedicated tables in this WordPress database. The plugin does not send chat contents to an external chat service.

Does this provide realtime push notifications?

Not yet. Messages are refreshed by polling and sound notifications are limited by browser audio policies. Native push notification support requires additional app-side infrastructure.

What information does the plugin store?

Conversation messages, a random pseudonymous visitor-session identifier (stored hashed in the database), the first page URL stripped of query parameters, timestamps, and app token hashes. A visitor browser stores its chat session in local storage. Site administrators should disclose chat data processing in their privacy notice.

Can I connect multiple agents?

Yes. Administrators and users with the Live Chat Agent capability can access the inbox. API keys are assigned to the WordPress user who generates them and can be individually revoked. Raw keys are never stored in WordPress. For secure client connections, use HTTPS.
sections.changelog:
0.5.12

  • Updated plugin branding and WordPress.org slug proposal following review feedback.
  • Made class, hooks, settings and new-install table identifiers more distinctive.
  • Added compatibility for legacy settings, conversations, user roles, and companion app API clients.
  • Corrected contributor username to globaldevitus.

0.5.11

  • Added the secure Generate API Key control to Apps, with per-agent keys displayed only once and revocation controls.
  • Added an authenticated REST API connection-test endpoint at /agent/me for future native clients.
  • Retained the Coming Soon presentation for Android, iOS and Windows.

0.5.10

  • Made all 26 retention-cleanup SQL replacements explicit to fix static placeholder counting.
  • Documented reviewed direct custom-table queries and non-cached real-time reads with narrowly scoped PHPCS annotations; these are intentional operations, not ignored security findings.
  • No changes to the chat widget, REST API, stored messages or database schema.

0.5.9

  • Resolved Plugin Check’s dynamic SQL placeholder errors in scheduled chat cleanup.
  • Processed expired conversation IDs in fixed-size prepared batches without changing retention settings.

0.5.7

  • Updated database reads and retention queries to use prepared identifier placeholders for custom tables.
  • Normalized and validated visitor IPs used only for abuse-prevention rate limiting.
  • Added Tested up to readme metadata.

0.5.6

  • Replaced companion app setup instructions with a Coming Soon page for Android, iOS and Windows.
  • Removed app-pairing controls from the page until applications are released. Existing tokens remain revocable.
  • Kept the underlying authenticated agent REST API unchanged.

0.5.5

  • Clarified the planned companion-app architecture and availability on the App Access screen.
  • Added site URL and API URL copy controls, connection instructions and correctly labeled token usage information.
  • Added WordPress.org-style plugin documentation and license metadata.

0.5.4

  • Unified administration headers and notices on Inbox, Settings and App Access.

0.5.3

  • Redesigned the WordPress inbox.

0.5.2

  • Added chat launcher placement controls.

0.5.1

  • Renamed the plugin Globaldev Live Chat Inbox.

0.5.0

  • Added widget layouts, color palettes and sound settings.
